onMiss: Read the flagged items first. prod_stopped or pause: find what stops prod reads (pause keys, supply holds and unbound accounts on crawler.virev.ai/ops/status) and steer the live engage job that owns it by message; start a job only when none owns it. idle_accounts: steer the bind or route-renew work for those ids. canary: fill the roster to ~10% through the instagram access canary job (p75). An instagram death: drop that arm's cap to the best proven rate and write the death codes on the board. If the accounts on hand cannot reach 100k at the measured pages per account a day, send the owner the Slack DM he asked for with that number, and never buy accounts. Ship staging changes directly (c50), ask only for prod promotes, merge nothing without his go on that PR (c49), and send nothing to an outside party (c37). source_error: fix the read. All on target: end the turn with no message.
